manifest.title_en: Respond to diarrhea and dehydration concerns
objectives_fil: Gamitin ang label ng sachet sa dry simulation, ipaliwanag ang ligtas na tubig at pagpapasuso, at tukuyin ang referral trigger.
objectives_en: Use the packet label in a dry simulation, explain safe water and continued feeding, and identify a referral trigger.

sections.takeaway_fil: Kaso: May malabnaw na dumi si sanggol Mina at sumususo pa
sections.takeaway_en: Case: Baby Mina has loose stools and is still breastfeeding

sections.takeaway_fil: Gamitin ang label ng sachet sa dry simulation, ipaliwanag ang ligtas na tubig at pagpapasuso, at tukuyin ang referral trigger.
sections.takeaway_en: Use the packet label in a dry simulation, explain safe water and continued feeding, and identify a referral trigger.

sections.takeaway_fil: Unahin ang kaligtasan at agarang tulong.

check.prompt_fil: Sa kasong ito, ano ang unang tugon?
check.prompt_en: In this case, what comes first?

options.fil: Gawin muna ang shortcut kahit walang kumpirmasyon.
options.en: Use the shortcut before confirming the facts.

options.fil: Maghintay muna at huwag ipaalam sa staff.
options.en: Wait without notifying the responsible staff.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Maaaring makapinsala ang shortcut: Huwag magbigay ng iisang homemade timpla o dami para sa lahat ng edad at sachet. Huwag piliting painumin kung hindi ligtas lumunok. 2: Unahin ang kaligtasan at agarang tulong. 3: Maaaring maantala ang kinakailangang assessment.
check.feedback_en: 1: The shortcut can cause harm: Do not give a fixed homemade recipe or fluid dose across all ages and packet sizes. Do not force oral fluids when swallowing is unsafe. 2: Prioritize safety and timely help. 3: Necessary assessment may be delayed.

sections.takeaway_fil: Gamitin ang label ng sachet sa dry simulation, ipaliwanag ang ligtas na tubig at pagpapasuso, at tukuyin ang referral trigger.
sections.takeaway_en: Use the packet label in a dry simulation, explain safe water and continued feeding, and identify a referral trigger.

sections.takeaway_fil: Kumpirmahin ang saklaw at kailangan sa tamang tao.
sections.takeaway_en: Confirm boundaries and requirements with the appropriate person.

sections.takeaway_fil: Obserbahan ang gawa at ang tamang referral.
sections.takeaway_en: Observe the task and appropriate referral.

check.prompt_fil: Ano ang dapat ipakita sa practice?

options.fil: Magbigay ng diagnosis mula sa kuwento at mangakong sapat na iyon para sa pasyente.
options.en: Diagnose from the story and promise it is enough for the person.

options.fil: Ulitin ang shortcut kahit may panganib at walang kumpirmadong tagubilin.
options.en: Repeat the shortcut despite the risk and without confirmed guidance.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Hindi batayan ang kuwento para sa sariling diagnosis. 2: Ang shortcut ay hindi ligtas: Huwag magbigay ng iisang homemade timpla o dami para sa lahat ng edad at sachet. Huwag piliting painumin kung hindi ligtas lumunok. 3: Obserbahan ang gawa at ang tamang referral.
check.feedback_en: 1: The story is not grounds for an independent diagnosis. 2: The shortcut is unsafe: Do not give a fixed homemade recipe or fluid dose across all ages and packet sizes. Do not force oral fluids when swallowing is unsafe. 3: Observe the task and appropriate referral.

sections.takeaway_fil: Subukan ang gawain at balikan ang resulta.
sections.takeaway_en: Try the task and review the result.
